capabilities: Embed T3 Code workspace in Obsidian
Add notes, folders, and selections to prompts
Open Markdown files in Obsidian from T3
Filter sessions to the current vault
Edit composer drafts in temporary notes
extras: Requires a local T3 server on the same computer and OS; a T3 server in WSL is not supported. Vault filtering only changes which sessions appear, not agent filesystem access.
problem: Working with T3 Code agents means leaving Obsidian and manually copying note content into prompts.

relations.evidence: threecode brings your T3 Code workspace into Obsidian.
reveal it in Notebook Navigator or File Tree Alternative.
reveal it in Notebook Navigator or File Tree Alternative.

summary: Plugin that embeds a T3 Code agent workspace in Obsidian and adds vault notes, folders, or selections to prompts.
